glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): a bird flying upwards. In its modern form, resembles a tasseled 升.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 飛. Recorded from at least 1955 by Zhao Xi (趙曦).
senses: [fēi] (intransitive, of insects, birds, etc.) to fly
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 飛; s_page_origin explains the simplified 飞.
